rationale: All four findings from code-review-final.json verified resolved by an adversarial check that proved each fix by mutation rather than by reading: reverting each of the six transport bodies one at a time makes exactly one parametrized test fail, and removing each new guard makes its own tests fail. One new finding was raised by the check round (CR-005: README still claimed the text was passed through unaltered after the fix-up made the bridge truncate and strip it, and the new env var was undocumented) and was fixed in the same round, commit 'Document the instruction size cap and no-overwrite rule'. Residual noted but not blocking: the raw unbounded string is still held in memory on ManagedClient for the cache TTL; only the response and its token cost are capped.

finding_status.evidence: sanitize_instructions (instructions.py:82-111) is called from the single chokepoint attach_server_instructions:133, which is the only route to a response on all four call sites (routes.py:207; single_usage.py:158,223,296). 20000 chars -> 8192 emitted with a truncation warning; only-control-char input -> dropped, not emitted empty; tab/LF/CR preserved, ESC stripped. Reverting the sanitize call fails 3 tests.

Guards at instructions.py:138-140 (dict) and :145-147 (pydantic). Real ListToolsResult carrying instructions='from-server' plus an extra key comes back with the server value kept and the extra key intact. Removing both guards fails 2 tests.

try/except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) at instructions.py:148-153 plus a warning on the unsupported-type fall-through. A frozen model and an extra=forbid model both come back as the same object, unchanged. Removing the try/except fails 2 tests. Docstring now matches the real aliasing.

Proven by source mutation in a throwaway copy: reverting each of managed.py:256,292,329 individually yields '1 failed, 4 passed' each time, and neutralizing each of single_usage.py:158,223,296 individually yields '1 failed, 3 passed' each time — so all six bodies are independently covered. /bridge now exercises a real ListToolsResult in both the with- and without-instructions cases. quality-gates.md gate 8 added and the stale 'exit 5 / coverage absent' trap row corrected.

New finding raised and fixed in this round: README.md now documents the control-character strip, the MCP_CONNECT_MAX_INSTRUCTIONS_CHARS cap and the no-overwrite rule, and the env var is listed in both the README env table (README.md:534) and .env.example:13.
